description: This file defines the Color class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling color representations, conversions, and validations for spreadsheet styling.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: Represents and manipulates colors within spreadsheet styling, supporting named and ARGB color formats, validation, and color adjustments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Color object with optional color value, supervisor, and conditional flags.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared style component for the active cell, used when this is a supervisor.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and retrieves a style array from subcomponents.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style properties from an array, updating the color accordingly.

methods.name: validateColor
methods.description: Validates and standardizes a color value, returning a proper ARGB hex string.

methods.name: getARGB
methods.description: Returns the ARGB color value; if supervisor, delegates to shared component.

methods.name: setARGB
methods.description: Sets the ARGB color value, marking the color as changed.

methods.name: getRGB
methods.description: Returns the RGB part of the color, excluding alpha, with supervisor delegation.

methods.name: setRGB
methods.description: Sets the RGB color value by delegating to setARGB.

methods.name: getColourComponent
methods.description: Extracts a specific color component from an RGB value.

methods.name: getRed
methods.description: Returns the red component of an RGB value.

methods.name: getGreen
methods.description: Returns the green component of an RGB value.

methods.name: getBlue
methods.description: Returns the blue component of an RGB value.

methods.name: changeBrightness
methods.description: Adjusts the brightness of a color by a specified percentage.

methods.name: indexedColor
methods.description: Retrieves a color from an indexed palette, defaulting to black or white if not found.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Computes a unique hash code for the color, used for style comparison.

methods.name: exportArray1
methods.description: Exports the color's attributes into an array format.

methods.name: getHasChanged
methods.description: Indicates if the color has been modified since creation.
